review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A general theory of soliton stability and interactions beyond integrable systems. Current methods (Evans functions, Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction) work case-by-case but no unified framework exists for arbitrary nonlinear evolution equations. Need: (1) Classification of all nonlinearity-dispersion balance conditions, (2) General collision theory for non-integrable solitons, (3) Rigorous perturbation theory for near-integrable systems
